issues: Scrambled list/numbering structure: items 14–16 in Article 1 are merged into a single paragraph; list markers 15 and 16 are not on their own numbered lines, risking boundary-based parsing errors.

Scrambled/merged list markers and paragraph numbering: several items are run together (e.g., 'andh.', 'andf.', 'andg.', 'andd.'), and Article 7 paragraph '(2)' is merged into paragraph (1) text; Article 8 paragraph '(3)' is merged into paragraph (2) text; multiple lettered subitems are merged on one line (e.g., 'b. ...; c. ...'). This breaks downstream boundary splitting.
Meaning drift/awkward rendering: 'melanjutkan keturunan' is better rendered as 'to procreate/continue the lineage' rather than 'continue descendants' (unclear English).

Scrambled/merged list structure: several lettered items (a–e, a–i, a–g, a–j, a–f, a–e) are run together on the same line as preceding text, and in Article 19 paragraph (2) is embedded in paragraph (1) instead of being a separate numbered item.

Scrambled/incorrect list structure in Article 17(1): items e and f are both preceded by 'and', whereas the original has 'and' only before item e and then 'and/or' before item f (dane. ... danf. ...).
Minor meaning drift in Article 17(1) list connectors: item f should be linked with 'and/or' (not a separate 'and' line), reflecting the original 'dan/atau' usage elsewhere in the document.

Meaning drift: Article 26 cross-references the wrong articles; original refers to Articles 21 through 23, but context shows it should refer to Articles 23 through 25 (Pengawasan/Evaluasi/Pembinaan).

Meaning drift in Article 26 cross-reference: original refers to Articles 21 through 23, but translation says Articles 23 through 25.
Scrambled/merged list structure in Article 5 letter c: list markers run together ("and/ord.") and should be separate item d.

Scrambled/merged list structure in Article 5 letter f: item c is merged into "and/orc." and should be separate item c.
